about: A MODEL of the Milky Way for the 3D view, not a measurement. Spiral arms from Reid et al. 2019 (Table 2), drawn beyond their data only as that paper describes (segments with fitted: false). Bar and bulge are illustrative. Built by scripts/galaxy/build_galaxy.py; see data/SOURCES.md.
spiral: ln(R/R_kink) = -(beta - beta_kink) tan(psi); beta is Galactocentric azimuth in degrees, 0 toward the Sun, increasing with Galactic rotation; psi = psi_lt for beta <= beta_kink, else psi_gt, unless a segment gives its own psi (then the spiral continues from where the previous segment ends).
z_width: sigma_z = 20 + 36 (R/kpc - 7) pc for R > 7 kpc, else 20 pc (Reid et al. 2019, section 3.1)

bar.note: Illustrative. Wegg et al. 2015: half-length 5.0 +- 0.2 kpc, 28-33 deg to the Sun-centre line, near end at positive longitude.

segments.note: Bar-related; the paper traces it only over 15-18 deg.
Continues the fitted pitch toward the end of the bar.
Section 3.2.2: extended beyond the Galactic Centre it becomes the Outer Scutum-Centaurus (OSC) arm.
Continues the fitted pitch toward the bar.
Section 3.2.3: beyond the tangency the pitch drops to 10 deg to match the CO trace of the Carina arm.
Section 3.2.3: psi about 17 deg out to the 4th-quadrant tangency.
Section 3.2.3: extended inward to the bar near (X, Y) = (-3, -3) kpc, by symmetry with the Norma arm.
A short continuation; the paper calls the Local arm an isolated segment.
Section 3.2.4: the arm weakens and may die out in the 3rd quadrant.
Section 3.2.4: extrapolated inward with pitch near 9 deg, passing outside the bar.
Section 3.2.1: near-zero pitch into the 3rd quadrant.
Section 3.2.1: the Norma arm most likely wraps round the far side of the Galactic Centre and becomes the Outer arm; continuing the Outer arm's pitch meets the Norma arm's start (5 deg + 360).

reid2019.cite: Reid et al. 2019, ApJ 885, 131 (spiral arms and R0 from maser parallaxes)

bennett2019.cite: Bennett & Bovy 2019, MNRAS 482, 1417 (the Sun's height above the mid-plane)

wegg2015.cite: Wegg, Gerhard & Portail 2015, MNRAS 450, 4050 (the long bar)
